comment: Identical architectures made optimizer progress the main discriminator. At 512 steps, Adam’s nominal displacement is 0.512, AdamW’s 0.1536, Adagrad’s approximately 0.045, and plain SGD’s approximately 0.005 under the classification gradient proxy. K1001–K1003 supported A ahead of the AdamW pair, then B, then C. K1005 supplied the weak lower-decay tie-break favoring E over D; that close ordering was less certain than the optimizer-rate gaps. The revealed ranking matches these expectations, but adds no new general rule or isolated mechanism.
